add_card-label: Adds an existing board label to a card by label id. Ask "Can you label card 7 with label id 42?" or "Can you put the existing bug label on card 9?" Use remove_card-label to take one off.
comment_card: Posts a comment with the given text on a card. Ask "Can you comment on card 7?" or "Can you post this update on card 9?" Use list_card-action to read comments and activity.
create_board-label: Creates a new label on a board with a given name and color. Try 'add a green label called ready' or 'create a label named blocked on board 123.' To see existing labels use list_board-label.
create_card: Creates a card in a list with name, description, due and start dates, labels, members, position, or a URL source. Ask "Can you create a card in list 7?" or "Can you add a card from this link?" Use set_card for existing card updates.
create_card-attachment: Attaches a URL to a card with an optional name, optionally as the cover. Ask "Can you attach this link to card 7?" or "Can you add this file URL as the cover on card 9?" Use list_card-attachment to see attachments.
create_card-checklist: Adds a checklist to a card with a name, optionally copied from another checklist. Ask "Can you create a checklist on card 7?" or "Can you copy the onboarding checklist to card 9?" Use list_card-checklist to see checklists on a card.
create_checklist-item: Adds an item to a checklist with a name and optional checked state, due date, or member. Try 'add wireframes to checklist 5f...' or 'add a due item to checklist 5f...?' To update that item use set_card-checkitem.
create_list: Creates a new list on a board with a name and position, optionally copying another list. Try 'create a list called QA on board 5f...' or 'copy list 5f... to a new column?' To move or archive it next use set_list.
delete_board-label: IRREVERSIBLE. Deletes the label everywhere, stripping it from every card that carries it across the whole board. To take a label off one card, use remove_card_label instead.
delete_card-attachment: IRREVERSIBLE. Trello has no archived state for an attachment, so this is the only way to take one off a card.
delete_checklist: IRREVERSIBLE. Removes the checklist and every item on it. Checklists have no archived state.
delete_checklist-item: IRREVERSIBLE. Check items have no archived state. To mark one done instead, use set_card-checkitem with state=complete.
get_board: Returns a single board's name, description, URL, closed flag, and preferences by id. Try 'show board details for board id 123' or 'is the marketing board open?' To change those fields use set_board.
get_card: Returns a card's name, description, due and start dates, list, labels, and optional actions, attachments, checklists, members, and custom field items. Ask "What's on card 7?" or "Which list is card 9 in?" Use set_card to update it.
get_checklist: Returns one checklist by id with its items and the card it belongs to. Try 'what checklist is 5f...?' or 'which card has checklist 5f...?' For item complete state use list_checklist-item.
get_list: Returns the name, board, closed flag, and position of one list by id. Try 'what list is 5f...?' or 'is this column closed?' For cards in that list use list_list-card.
list_board-card: Returns every card on one board with open, closed, all, or visible filters. Try 'show all cards on board 123' or 'what cards are open on the roadmap board?' For cards grouped by column use list_board-list.
list_board-checklist: Returns every checklist on every card of one board. Try 'list checklists on board 123' or 'what checklists are on the roadmap board?' For cards on the board use list_board-card.
list_board-label: Returns the labels defined on a board with their names and colors. Try 'list labels on board 123' or 'what labels does the design board have?' To add a label use create_board-label.
list_board-list: Returns the lists and columns on one board, filtered by open or closed, optionally with cards in each list. Try 'what columns are on board 123?' or 'show lists with cards on the roadmap board.' For cards across the whole board use list_board-card.
list_board-member: Returns the members of one board. Try 'who is on board 123?' or 'list members of the roadmap board.' For boards visible to the signed-in member use list_my-board.
list_card-action: Returns a card's activity history including comments, moves, and updates, filterable by action type such as commentCard. Ask "What's the history of card 7?" or "What comments are in card 9 activity?" Use comment_card to post a comment.
list_card-attachment: Returns the attachments on a card. Ask "What's attached to card 7?" or "What files are on card 9?" Use create_card-attachment to add a URL attachment.
list_card-checklist: Returns the checklists on a card with their items. Ask "What checklists are on card 7?" or "What are the checklist items on card 9?" Use create_card-checklist to add one.
list_card-custom-field: Returns the custom field values set on a card. Ask "Which custom fields are on card 7?" or "What is the estimate for card 9?" Use get_card for general card details.
list_card-member: Returns the members assigned to a card. Ask "Who's assigned to card 7?" or "Who is on card 9?" Use set_card to update members.
list_checklist-item: Returns the items on one checklist with their complete or incomplete state. Try 'what items are on checklist 5f...?' or 'which checklist items are done?' To mark one complete use set_card-checkitem.
list_list-card: Returns the cards in one list, filterable to open, closed, or all. Try 'what cards are in the Done column?' or 'show all cards in list 5f...?' For list metadata use get_list.
list_my-board: Returns all boards the signed-in member can see with open, closed, or all filters and optional lists and organization. Try 'what boards do I have?' or 'show my closed boards.' For one board's details use get_board.
mcp_beaver_info: Report this MCP server's identity, mode, and served tool inventory. Read-only, reaches no upstream, and doubles as a liveness probe now that the protocol ping is gone.
remove_card-label: Takes one label off a card by label id and leaves the board label intact. Ask "Can you remove label id 5 from card 7?" or "Can you take the bug label off card 9?" Use add_card-label to attach a label.
search_trello: Returns full-text matches across boards, cards, members, and organizations for a query. Try 'search all boards for design' or 'find cards about billing.' For every card on one board use list_board-card.
set_board: Updates a board's name, description, closed flag, or subscription. Try 'archive the roadmap board' or 'rename board 123 to launch.' To read current board fields use get_board.
set_card: Updates a card by renaming, changing description, due and start dates, marking due complete, moving list or board, setting labels or members, position, cover, archiving or unarchiving, and subscribing. Ask "Can you move card 7 to Testing?" or "Can you archive card 9?" Use get_card to read it.
set_card-checkitem: Updates one checklist item on a card to change its checked state, name, due date, reminder, member, or position. Try 'mark checklist item 5f... done' or 'move checklist item 5f... to top'. For the full item list use list_checklist-item.
set_checklist: Updates a checklist's name or position. Try 'rename checklist 5f... to launch' or 'move checklist 5f... to top'. For current checklist details and card use get_checklist.
set_list: Updates one list to rename it, move it to another board or position, set its closed state, or subscribe. Try 'archive list 5f...?' or 'rename list 5f... to QA?' For the list before edits use get_list.
